header.title: How to Repair a Washing Machine that Is Unbalanced
header.description: This guide provides simple steps to troubleshoot and fix a washing machine that's experiencing balance issues. By checking the level, adjusting the legs, and ensuring proper drum tightness, you can often resolve the problem.

steps.description: Use a level to determine if the washing machine is off balance.
actions: to see how much off balance the washing machine is

steps.description: Adjust the washing machine's legs to ensure it is level.
actions: Adjust front legs by screwing them in or out.
Lift the back end of the washing machine.
Allow the back legs to reset.
Lower the back end of the washing machine.

steps.description: If the washing machine drum is loose, tighten it to prevent it from walking.
Avoid spinning large items in the machine to prevent noise and shaking.
